title: The End of the Quest
description: A lone armored figure with a staff stands on a purple cliff edge beside a wooden sign reading 'THE END' with red drips. In the surreal fantasy landscape, a large detailed dragon flies across a swirling purple and orange sky carrying a small rider and a glowing orb, while a gothic castle sits atop a distant mountain range above a winding path and patterned foreground.
prompt: A lone armored adventurer with a staff stands on a purple cliff edge next to a wooden sign that reads THE END with red drips below it.
